title: Enigma M3 key
description: The daily key-sheet settings plus the message start position for the Army and Air Force Enigma I. Every member lists the machine left to right, as an operator reads it; the last rotor is the fast one.

rotors.description: Walzenlage: three different rotors, left to right.

rings.description: Ringstellung as letters, left to right. A is no offset; 01 on a key sheet is A.

positions.description: Window letters at the start, left to right: the message key.

plugboard.description: Steckerverbindungen: up to 10 pairs of letters. No letter may appear twice, and a letter cannot pair with itself; that rule is in the spec (ENC-ENIG-003), not this schema.
